exact_target: Compute the cohomological Brauer group of every separated finite-type tame algebraic stack of pure dimension one with finite inertia over an algebraically closed field.
exact_partial_results: Dense-schematic-open tame Artin curve: sum of Schur multiplier groups of étale stabilizer quotients.
Same coarse P1 and stabilizer μl² everywhere: neutral product has Br=Z/l while O(1) root gerbe times Bμl has Br=0.
A1 times Bμp in characteristic p: explicit infinite Artin–Schreier quotient and prime-to-p-degree normal form.
remaining_gap: Arbitrary generic bands, sheaves, transgressions and extension data are not computed.
novelty: Unconfirmed; local cohomology and gerbe/classifying-stack inputs explicitly credited.
